details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is fully coherent internally. All statements logically support each other without contradictions. The summary begins with an overall performance statement (S1), then details revenue changes (S2-S3), profitability improvements (S5-S10), operational metrics (S13-S16), financial position (S17-S19), and forward outlook (S20). Explanations consistently reference prior statements (e.g., S5 references S2-S4, S7-S8 reference S5-S6). No arithmetic contradictions exist because the summary never claims exhaustive additivity of segment figures. Organization is clear with logical flow from performance overview to financials to outlook. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all relationships (cause-effect, comparisons) are logically sound.
